_description: Frozen Cox C-indices for InCHIANTI age65+ cohort — single source of truth for figure_mortality_prediction.pdf (InCHIANTI half). Values are copied verbatim from the inchianti_survival.py pipeline output captured in results/inchianti_survival_analysis.json. Do NOT edit by hand — regenerate by rerunning the pipeline and copying the values.
cohort: InCHIANTI baseline age >= 65, 4-axis (I, M, N, F), matched complete-case across all models (biomarkers + Fried frailty)
n_events_note: Manuscript text reports 706 deaths in the pre-matched age65+ subset (N=931, complete 4-axis biomarkers). After additionally requiring complete Fried frailty to match M4/M5 covariates, 8 frailty-incomplete subjects (all deceased) are dropped, yielding 923 / 698 for the matched sample on which all five models are fit.

delta_C._note: Matched complete-case sample of N=923 used for all models; biomarkers alone (M4a-M4=+0.014) carry the dominant incremental signal above Fried frailty, SWDS-Gamma alone (M4b-M4=+0.007) is roughly half.
